translation.example:
import numpy as np
from slam import rollup, simple_triplet_matrix
from slam._arrays import as_matrix
m = simple_triplet_matrix([1, 2, 1], [1, 1, 2], [1, 2, 3], 2, 2)
print(as_matrix(rollup(m, 2, fun=np.sum)))
